entries.name: ci_raw.metallib
entries.role: Core Image filter kernels (colour, blur, composite, generators, distortion)
entries.note: RAW processing library. BifrOSt reads the file and runs the colour path as CPU reference kernels: raw_container.rs (TIFF/DNG directory walk, uncompressed strips of 1 to 16 bits, CFA pattern, black and white level, as-shot neutral, ColorMatrix1), bayer.rs (demosaic and white balance), raw_color.rs (colour matrix and sRGB curve), raw_params.rs (parameter model). Compressed sensor data (lossless JPEG, vendor packings) is refused with RawError::Compressed, not decoded. Built 2026-10-17. role inferred from the owning framework path; the metallib was not disassembled Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Ready: RAW file to display RGB in springboard/render. raw_container.rs reads TIFF-structured DNG-style files (IFD and SubIFD walk, uncompressed 1-16 bit strips, 2x2 CFA pattern, black and white level, as-shot neutral, ColorMatrix1); RawImage::to_rgb16 chains bayer.rs (demosaic, white balance) and raw_color.rs applies the colour matrix and sRGB curve. Tests raw_container::tests, bayer::tests, raw_color::tests. Compressed sensor data (lossless JPEG, vendor codecs) is refused with a specific error rather than decoded. Clean-room: written from public algorithm descriptions for the job this library serves; the metallib was not disassembled or compared.

Clean-room: written from public algorithm descriptions for the job this library serves; the metallib was not disassembled or compared.

entries.ready_note: Ready: vector-tile drawing geometry in springboard/render/src/map_tile.rs (stroke_polyline with joins and caps, road casing/fill, triangulate_polygon, simplify_polyline, point_at for road labels, lonlat_to_tile), tests map_tile::tests and stroke_coverage::tests. Tile decoding and the map view's use of these are separate from this shader job. Clean-room: written from public algorithm descriptions for the job this library serves; the metallib was not disassembled or compared.

entries.name: CoreImageKernels.ci.metallib
entries.role: Computer-vision, computational photography or ML image processing shaders
entries.note: Portrait pipeline kernels exist as CPU code: kernel_portrait_matte.rs (trimap from depth, matte refinement with the guided filter, gather bokeh blur with highlight boost that keeps a sharp subject from smearing, subject composite, circle-of-confusion radius), depth_blur.rs, masked_blur.rs, portrait_lighting.rs and guided.rs. Depth and the first matte come from the caller; no trained model ships. Built 2026-10-17. role inferred from the owning bundle path; the metallib was not disassembled Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Ready: portrait image kernels in springboard/render: kernel_portrait_matte.rs (trimap, guided matte refinement, bokeh blur, composite, CoC radius), depth_blur.rs, masked_blur.rs, portrait_lighting.rs (relighting), guided.rs. Tests kernel_portrait_matte::tests, depth_blur::tests, portrait_lighting::tests, masked_blur::tests, guided::tests. Depth and the initial matte are inputs; the kernels need no trained weights. Clean-room: written from public algorithm descriptions for the job this library serves; the metallib was not disassembled or compared.

The relighting curves are not the reference ones. Built 2026-10-17: relight() in portrait_lighting.rs. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Ready: the depth-driven blur (depth_blur.rs) and the depth-map relighting (portrait_lighting.rs) cover this library's portrait and computational photography job on the CPU, each with host tests. The convolve, source-over and histogram kernels live in springboard/ui/src/image_kernels.rs. Trained model weights are not part of this row.
